headline: AngloGold Ashanti to invest $900 million in gold mine expansions
summary: AngloGold Ashanti plans to invest $900 million to expand gold mines in Tanzania, Guinea, and Brazil. The project aims to increase the company's annual production by at least 400,000 ounces by the end of the decade.
why: AngloGold Ashanti is one of the world's largest gold producers; its capital expenditure decisions significantly influence global supply and regional economic development in its host countries.

impacts.name: AngloGold Ashanti
impacts.why: Large capital investments impact long-term production capacity and cash flow.
